title: Jezebel
lead: Jezebel, daughter of the Sidonian king Ethbaal, married King Ahab of Israel, promoted the worship of Baal, hunted down the LORD's prophets and arranged Naboth's death (1 Kings 16:31; 1 Kings 18:4; 1 Kings 19:2; 1 Kings 21; 2 Kings 9:30–37). Her name became a byword: Revelation gives it to a woman teacher in the church at Thyatira who "calls herself a prophet" (Revelation 2:20).
